All 12 introductions, 8 scene assets, 9 speakers, three acts and unlocked clue file; actual rival grid and reduced-motion pixels.

Every victory line and callback tested with isolated real CutscenePlayer fixture; animated radio canvas inspected.
Every intro/victory line resolves the authored music cue; held dialogue, camera angles, Back, log and motion pause preserve transport; race transitions restore course songs.

pivotalScenes.name: rain-near-confession
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.ja: アキ。冗談にしないで言いたいことが……ああ、こんな時に電話か。
dialogue.en: Aki. There is something I want to say without making a joke… Of course the phone rings now.

pivotalScenes.name: betrayal-confession
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.ja: 僕が渡した。母の返済を待ってもらう代わりに。機材を置いた人には、契約も住所を渡すことも知らせなかった。
dialogue.en: I gave them the list to buy time for my mother’s debt. I never told the hosts about the contract or that I shared their addresses.

pivotalScenes.name: public-confession
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.ja: SORAラジオの空井レンです。中継先の情報を、皆さんに知らせずスポンサーに渡しました。
dialogue.en: This is Ren Sorai of SORA Radio. I gave the sponsor your relay details without telling you.

pivotalScenes.name: public-confession-reverse
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: mei
dialogue.ja: マイクを受け取る人の列、長いね。怒っている人もいる。今日は途中で切らないよ。
dialogue.en: That is a long queue for the microphone. Some people are angry. We will not cut them off.

pivotalScenes.name: jun-premiere
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: jun
dialogue.ja: SORAラジオをお聴きのみんなへ。長く待たせた新曲です。今度は、最後まで弾くよ。
dialogue.en: To everyone listening to SORA Radio: a new song, a long time coming. This time, I am playing it through.

pivotalScenes.name: jun-premiere-reverse
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.ja: この番組は録音です。今ごろ僕も日光で聴いているはず。今日だけは、曲のあとに黙ってみようと思います。
dialogue.en: This show is recorded. I should be listening at Nikko too. Just for today, I think I will leave some silence after the song.

pivotalScenes.name: romance-confession-now
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: aki
dialogue.ja: 本当に黙っちゃった。……レン、好きだよ。工房で会うだけじゃ、足りなくなった。次の休み、二人で出かけたい。
dialogue.en: You really did go quiet. Ren, I love you. Seeing you at the garage is not enough anymore. I want our next day off to be just us.

pivotalScenes.name: romance-consent-question
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: aki
dialogue.ja: 今、キスしてもいい？ ……この答えは、放送には乗せないでね。
dialogue.en: May I kiss you? And please keep this answer off the air.

pivotalScenes.name: romance-consent-answer
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.ja: うん。僕も、そうしたい。ほら、マイクは持ってない。テープも、まだ止まってる。
dialogue.en: Yes. I want that too. Look, no microphone. And the tape is still stopped.

pivotalScenes.name: romance-first-kiss
pivotalScenes.evidence: Isolated real CutscenePlayer with current campaign dialogue; no race win or campaign unlock earned.

dialogue.speaker: aki
dialogue.ja: ……録音、押すね。お腹すいた。最初の一言、こんなのでいい？
dialogue.en: I am pressing record now. I am hungry. Is that all right for the first thing on side B?
